summary: Pinned the documentation boundary around the one asserted defect. The defect rests on two documented statements, the exported field's own description and the overview's presentation of the summary call as a facility for querying Raft-group state; the changelog was the remaining place a promise about the field could plausibly live, and it says only that witness support was added as an experimental feature, naming neither the summary nor the field nor any reporting guarantee. That boundary is now a Fact: the requirement is anchored on the field description and the query surface, not on a changelog entry, and the experimental label on the witness feature does not by itself excuse a field whose own description states what it reports. No execution, conclusion or gap changed; the audit remains complete with all questions closed and the witness summary reporting as its single asserted finding.
